send-mail(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual					      send-mail(1)

NAME
       send-mail - Send an e-mail to a list of recipients containing configuration or statistical information about the BIG-IP(r)
       system.

MODULE
       All tmsh modules.

DESCRIPTION
       You can use the send-mail command to send an analytics report from the BIG-IP system to a list of e-mail recipients.

SEE ALSO
       analytics report, tmsh
